timeline.tweet: Ditto... I used to put it down to migraines...but after Drs support and advice they were the after effect on my anxiety. I'm not afraid to say that both love and medication are getting me through it. Good luck on your journey 😃xx

You will have good and bad days... Roll with them.. You will start to figure out your trigger points but will still be caught out some days... Anxiety likes to play peek-a-boo at times .. Keep that positivity and 'Embrace the glorious mess that you are'... I do 🤗

Ditto!!! Please do not feel like a failure. I was in the same position a few days ago... anxiety hit me from nowhere... but I had to go out to do errands for my parents. Then had to repeat the next day for work. Take baby steps and day by day! You are stronger than you think!!!

Ditto... and as my anti anxiety medication has increased, so has my anxiety. It feels like a vicious circle with no specific trigger factors. Day by day and baby steps.. thats how I'm trying to work it. Keep going and stay strong 😀
Have to admit I've gone down the medication route to aid in my anxiety and depression and its really helped, but have done other things to aid also 😊. You will find what suits you. 👍
